client_id.desc: Issued when you created your application. If possible, avoid sending `client_id` and `client_secret` as parameters in your request and instead supply the Client ID and Client Secret using the HTTP Basic authentication scheme.

client_secret.desc: Issued when you created your application. If possible, avoid sending `client_id` and `client_secret` as parameters in your request and instead supply the Client ID and Client Secret using the HTTP Basic authentication scheme.

code.desc: The `code` param returned via the OAuth callback.

code_verifier.desc: The code\_verifier param used to generate the code\_challenge originally. Used for PKCE.

grant_type.desc: The `grant_type` param as described in the OAuth spec.

redirect_uri.desc: This must match the originally submitted URI (if one was sent).

refresh_token.desc: The `refresh_token` param as described in the OAuth spec.

desc: Exchanges a temporary OAuth verifier code for a user access token.

errors.app_not_admin_approved: The app has not been approved by an org admin, so no tokens can be issued for this user. Ask an org admin to approve the app before requesting a token with the `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` grant.
errors.app_not_org_installed: The app is not installed at the organization level. Using the `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` grant type requires org level app installs.
errors.bad_redirect_uri: Value passed for `redirect_uri` did not match the `redirect_uri` in the original request.
errors.cannot_install_an_org_installed_app: Returned when the the org-installed app cannot be installed on a workspace.
errors.client_id_mismatch: Value passed for `client_id` did not match the `client_id` in the assertion.
errors.ema_issuer_mismatch: The issuer in the assertion did not match the issuer configured for enterprise-managed auth.
errors.invalid_audience: The audience in the assertion is not one this token endpoint supports.
errors.invalid_refresh_token: The given refresh token is invalid.
errors.no_app_scopes_requested: None of the scopes requested in the identity assertion are configured on the app. Request only scopes the app already declares.
errors.no_approved_scopes_requested: The app is approved by org admins, but none of the requested scopes are approved ones. Ask an org admin to approve the requested scopes.
errors.no_user_scopes: Missing user `scope` in the auth request.
errors.oauth_authorization_url_mismatch: The OAuth flow was initiated on an incorrect version of the authorization url. The flow must be initiated via /oauth/v2/authorize .
errors.preview_feature_not_available: Returned when the API method is not yet available on the team in context.
errors.user_not_authenticated: The user has never authenticated via single sign-on.
